comment: The Client Registry is described as the health sector’s “identity DPI.” This risks collapsing several distinct health-identity capabilities into one component, including identity resolution, authentication, credentials, consent, assurance, and trust services.

public.text: The Client Registry is described as the health sector’s “identity DPI.” This risks collapsing several distinct health-identity capabilities into one component, including identity resolution, authentication, credentials, consent, assurance, and trust services.
public.suggestedRevision: Describe the Client Registry as the health sector’s authoritative person-identity resolution and cross-referencing component, which works with foundational identity, authentication, consent, and national trust infrastructure.
